review_basis.review_scope: Independent review of candidate rule definitions only

findings.finding: Positive-rule REJECTS_RULE_ONLY outcomes are explicitly separated from target-level DOES_NOT_RELATE outcomes.
findings.evidence: CR1, CR2, and CTX1-CTX3 carry same-target guards; CR3 and CTX4A-CTX4C require complete rule-set evidence.

findings.finding: H4-derived completeness candidates require complete applicable-rule-set evidence and prohibit absence-of-discovery as negative evidence.
findings.evidence: CR3 and CTX4A-CTX4C explicitly require completeness, authority, provenance, applicability, typing, and dependency conditions.

findings.finding: Construction authority is not treated as RuleAuthorityRecord_x authority.
findings.evidence: The candidate artifact states that no rule-authority records are instantiated and that construction authority is non-equivalent.

findings.finding: All nine candidates remain non-instantiated and therefore cannot independently establish governed mapping results.
findings.evidence: Every candidate has record_status NOT_INSTANTIATED; rule authority, provenance, and dependency completeness are explicitly absent.

findings.finding: Candidate evaluation remains UNDEFINED until exact typing, applicability, authority, provenance, and independent PRE_REF_ORIENT dependency evidence are available.
findings.evidence: The undefined conditions and dependency contract require those unresolved inputs to remain undefined.

findings.finding: The nine candidates are sufficient to begin later authority review as hypothesis-derived candidates, but they are not shown exhaustive and do not establish rule-set completeness.
findings.evidence: The completeness contract requires external and candidate rule closure; no additional family is required before this review, but omission remains a future completeness question.

findings.finding: Threshold outcomes are not used to create carrier or context mapping semantics.
findings.evidence: Positive candidates and carrier non-relation explicitly preserve threshold independence.

open_gates: Instantiate and independently validate RuleAuthorityRecord_x only after candidate review approval.
Instantiate independently governed carrier and context mapping records only after exact type and applicability resolution.
Validate BridgeProvenanceRecord_x for each governed rule.
Generate and validate an independent DependencyGraphCompletenessRecord_x.
Do not construct witnesses until the preceding gates pass.
